Clear, well-organized presentation with excellent reproducibility: detailed methodology, pseudocode, multiple complementary analyses, comprehensive appendices with ablations on model scales, LoRA ranks, and additional architectures

weaknesses: Limited conceptual novelty: the core observation that undertraining can benefit merging was hinted at in concurrent work (Zhou et al. 2025, Pari et al. 2024); the contribution is more in systematic analysis than discovery of a fundamentally new phenomenon
